description: Recent records from a common Seattle open dataset (data.seattle.gov) by friendly name — no Socrata id needed. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "recent crime in Seattle", "Seattle fire 911 calls", "Seattle business licenses", "Seattle code complaints". Names: crime, fire911, business, code_complaints. Returns the latest rows (newest-first). Add a SoQL `where` to filter; for anything else use seattle_query.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

dataset.description: One of: crime, fire911, business, code_complaints.

where.description: Optional SoQL filter, e.g. "offense='BURGLARY'". Omit for all recent rows.

name: seattle_recent
title: Seattle Recent
